item.title: 10 Sci-Fi Books You Need to Read Before At Least Once In Your Life
item.description: Science fiction remains one of storytelling's most expansive playgrounds, capable of charting distant space just as easily as it exposes the imminent horrors of near-future technology. At its peak, sci-fi uses invented technology and distant planets to interrogate what it means to be human, cracking open eternal philosophical questions that more grounded genres simply can’t.

item.title: Magic: The Gathering’s 10 Best Uncommon Star Trek Cards, Ranked
item.description: Magic: The Gathering has never been shy about crossing over with other beloved franchises, and its latest Universes Beyond set takes players into the final frontier. The Star Trek set pulls together characters, spacecraft, alien civilizations, and iconic moments from across the franchise's decades-long history, translating them into Magic ’s mechanics. It's an ambitious crossover that gives longtime Trekkies plenty to get excited about, even if UB sets haven't always been embraced by Magic 's more traditional player base.

item.title: 66 Years Later, William Shatner's Forgotten 'Twilight Zone' Is Still a Haunting Masterpiece
item.description: “Nightmare at 20,000 Feet” is one of the all-time great episodes of The Twilight Zone . Starring William Shatner, the story is about a man who is taking his first flight after having had a nervous breakdown. During the flight, he looks out the window and sees a creature, called a gremlin, on the wing that taunts him and tears apart pieces of the plane. No one can see the gremlin but him, and even his own wife attributes it to his fragile mental state. The story is a brilliant commentary on paranoia and Shatner was captivating in the role. It was so good that it sometimes overshadows Shatner’s other great episode of The Twilight Zone , which premiered 66 years ago today.

item.title: 63 Years Later, the Best 'Peanuts' Sally Line Is Still an Iconic Comic Strip Quote
item.description: Charlie Brown might be the unluckiest character in the Western canon. The degree to which the universe conspires to dump misfortune directly on his head over and over is the beating heart of Charles Schulz's Peanuts . If you've got any problems at all, you can check in on good ol' Charlie Brown and be slightly cheered up by the knowledge that at least you've got it better than him.

item.title: GTA 6's Release Will Stress The Internet Just As Everything's Falling Apart
item.description: In early November, some internet service providers warned their customers that pre-downloads of Grand Theft Auto 6 were causing network slowdown issues for everyone on the service. That problem became visible before millions of gamers tried to log into the same game simultaneously. A long list of recent outages and issues across industries reliant on tech and network services now makes it seem likely that the biggest game launch of all time won't go down smoothly.

item.title: 5 Big Takeaways From the 2026 Game Awards Nominations
item.description: Despite the dramatic timing — before Grand Theft Auto 6 's release, even before reviews for Rockstar's game have been published — nominations for The Game Awards 2026 weren't very surprising. This was always going to be GTA 6 's year.

item.title: Resident Evil Requiem’s Game Awards Nominee Is Ready for Resident Evil 10
item.description: Angela Sant'Albano had never performed in a video game before Resident Evil Requiem . She'd never done motion capture, either. But after spending months physically throwing herself into the horror of Grace Ashcroft's story, she came away convinced that the medium was a perfect fit.

item.title: When Are The Game Awards 2026: Date, Time, and How to Watch
item.description: The biggest annual video game awards ceremony, The Game Awards , is almost here, likely bringing big wins, a few upsets, too many game trailers, and maybe even an acceptance speech or two.

item.title: Magic: The Gathering Boss Reveals the Next Marvel Set’s Surprising Origin Story
item.description: Magic: The Gathering has already released two Universes Beyond sets based on Marvel Comics , with Marvel’s Spider-Man in 2025 and Marvel Super Heroes in 2026. The game’s designers are taking a very different approach to their third tie-in set, Darkhold Destiny , which will launch in 2027. Rather than simply making cards based on iconic characters and comic book arcs, Wizards of the Coast designers worked with Marvel to create an entirely new storyline designed with the game’s mechanics in mind. Magic ’s vice president of design Aaron Forsythe told Polygon at MagicCon Atlanta that the inspiration for the new approach came from an unlikely source.

item.title: GTA 6's Game Awards Nominations Are Exactly What Everyone Predicted
item.description: Going into Tuesday’s reveal of the 2026 Game Awards nominees , the question wasn’t whether or not Grand Theft Auto 6 would pick up any nominations. It was more about how many nominations it would get. And now that the dust has cleared, GTA 6 ’s Game Awards nominations rolled out pretty much…exactly as expected.
